attchmntText: Audio Recording of virtual Earnings Conference Call to discuss the financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has made available the audio link of the Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call. The call was held on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is accessible on the company website at the specified URL. This communication is in continuation of the notice dated November 19, 2026. The filing is submitted under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Press Release for the unaudited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited submitted its unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 25, 2026. The press release reports H1 FY27 revenue from operations at Rs. 2,966.7 Mn, an 80.5% increase year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 200.5 Mn, up 86.9% year-on-year, with a margin of 6.8%. Profit after tax rose to Rs. 35.8 Mn from Rs. 0.4 Mn in H1 FY26. The closing order book as of September 30, 2026, was Rs. 16,561.7 Mn. The intimation was uploaded to the company website.

attchmntText: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Ltd. filed an Analysts and Investors Presentation regarding its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The filing was submitted to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 25, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website. Consolidated revenue for the half year was Rs. 2,966.7 Mn, up 80.5% year over year. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 200.5 Mn, up 86.9%. Profit after tax was Rs. 35.8 Mn, compared to Rs. 0.4 Mn in the prior period. For the second quarter, revenue was Rs. 1,627.3 Mn, up 68.5%. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 101.9 Mn, up 79.0%. Profit after tax was Rs. 21.0 Mn, compared to Rs. 3.2 Mn in the prior period.

attchmntText: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited submitted newspaper clippings to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 25, 2026. The submission confirms the publication of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Navshakti on November 25, 2026. The filing was made by Company Secretary Shweta Deshpande. The document also contains unrelated notices from Kurtosis Analytics & Advisors regarding SEBI registration and from another entity regarding a special window for transfer and dematerialization of physical shares.

attchmntText: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting concluded on November 23, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 998.51 million rupees for the quarter and 1,640.52 million rupees for the half year. Profit after tax stood at 50.78 million rupees for the quarter and 117.78 million rupees for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 0.57 rupees for the quarter and 1.26 rupees for the half year. Total assets were 10,165.41 million rupees as of September 30, 2026. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report confirming no material misstatements.
